calls.title: Dropbox - AI & GrowthBook
calls.summary: Dropbox is nearing full adoption of GrowthBook for experimentation, with nearly 80% of users migrated from the legacy tool. The meeting outlined efforts to streamline onboarding and manage lifecycle issues, including the cleanup of stale feature flags. New API endpoints in the upcoming 4.4 release aim to enhance rollout control and support automation. There is also a focus on adopting AI for automated reporting and insight generation, all while ensuring safety through newly established guardrails for metadata changes. The collaboration between Dropbox and GrowthBook is crucial for optimizing lifecycle management and preparing for further AI integration in the future.
calls.keywords: Growth Book, feature flagging, AI automation, experimentation workflow, API endpoints, data science
calls.action_items:

Send snapshot build information and details about new 4.4 API endpoints to Dropbox team for early preview to facilitate integration and lifecycle tooling improvements (32:45)

**Scott Bailey**
